name: Vaseline Lip Therapy Aloe Vera | 20g
description:
Product details of Lip Therapy Aloe Vera – 20g

Product Type: Lip Balm / Lip Therapy

Size: 20g

Origin: Made in Poland

Key Features:

Long-Lasting Moisturization: Helps heal dry and chapped lips

Non-Sticky & Non-Greasy: Smooth, easy application

Aloe Vera Infused: Fresh, soothing aloe scent for a pleasant experience

Natural Glossy Shine: Leaves lips looking healthy and radiant

Healing Formula: Combines the benefits of Vaseline Jelly in a lip-specific formula
